scope: Headless GUT shutdown after all project tests. Raw counts include Godot-held global script classes; they may only be recalibrated after an audited pinned GF vendor-tree or project runtime class-set change, and must not grow while both inputs remain unchanged.
calibration_reason: The exact official GF 11.0.0-dev.0 development snapshot is pinned at 4488c65f after the canonical full validation and merge gate succeeded. GF 11 retires the Package Manager and package CLI, moves bounded ZIP support under Config Pipeline, and reduces the audited GF global script class set from 877 to 874. The audited project runtime class set is 291 after adding the typed GameSaveProfileSettlementEvidence, GameSaveSectionSettlementResult, and GameSaveSectionSettlementWaiter Modules; Godot remains pinned to 4.7.2. The reviewed ObjectDB, Resource, RID, and PagedAllocator ceilings are intentionally retained without increase.
